title: VendPoint Category Note: Wear Allowance on Newly Added Items
content:
Category management note for the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program, applying to the par Corbett sets for the item most recently added to a machine in its start-up par review.

The wear allowance follows the item's product category on its add entry: an item in the safety and PPE category carries the PPE wear allowance, an item in the cutting tools or the abrasives category carries the consumable wear allowance, and any other item carries none.

| Product category on the item's add entry | Wear allowance |
|---|---|
| Safety and PPE | PPE wear allowance: 0.5 |
| Cutting tools | Consumable wear allowance: 0.25 |
| Abrasives | Consumable wear allowance: 0.25 |
| Any other category (fasteners, electrical, janitorial and every other) | None |

The category read is the one written on the item's add entry in the machine's selection history, not a category stated by the caller.

**Examples.** A hypothetical box of nitrile gloves added in the safety and PPE category carries 0.5; a hypothetical grinding disc added under abrasives carries 0.25; a hypothetical hex bolt added under fasteners carries none.
